{{Quote|Can you ''smell'' the history, the power here?|Exar Kun|<ref name="TOTJ:TSW5">[[Tales of the Jedi – The Sith War 5|''Tales of the Jedi – The Sith War'' 5]]</ref>}}
The '''Great Jedi Library''', also known as the '''Library of Ossus''' or as the '''Great Library of the Jedi''', was a massive [[Library/Legends|library]] complex consisting of several buildings erected by the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ossus/Legends|Ossus]]. Commissioned by the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Odan-Urr/Legends|Odan-Urr]] following the [[Great Hyperspace War/Legends|Great Hyperspace War]], the [[Draethos/Legends|Draethos]] Jedi assembled ancient documents and scrolls detailing every detail of [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] history and ingenuity. Home to the Order after leaving their homeworld [[Tython/Legends|Tython]] in the [[Deep Core/Legends|Deep Core]], the Great Library became a symbol of the Jedi and the great storehouse of knowledge in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. Over the ensuing centuries Ossus thrived as the home of Jedi wisdom, encouraging visitors from across the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] to visit and study at the archives.

After centuries of peace and growth, the Library was raided by [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Exar Kun/Legends|Exar Kun]] and his followers. Storming the [[Chamber of Antiquities/Legends|Chamber of Antiquities]], the Sith stole the forbidden [[Sith artifact/Legends|Sith artifact]] known as the [[Dark Holocron]] from Master Odan-Urr before slaying the venerable Jedi. As Kun grew stronger and gathered his forces, the Sith unleashed the devastation of [[Naga Sadow/Legends|Naga Sadow's]] ancient battleship, the [[Corsair (Derriphan-class)|''Corsair'']], [[Cron Supernova/Legends|detonating]] the stars of the nearby [[Cron Cluster/Legends|Cron Cluster]] in [[3996 BBY]].

As the Jedi desperately tried to empty the Library and ship its contents offworld, Kun and his minions [[Battle of Ossus (Great Sith War)|returned]] in a bid to steal the last bits of knowledge from the Jedi. Before long, the world was irradiated by the supernovas, eradicating the planet's major cities and entombing more than half of the Library's knowledge within its halls. The Library stood abandoned for the next three millennia, while the surviving Jedi known as the [[Ysanna/Legends|Ysanna]] kept constant vigil in the ruined world. The Jedi who had made it offworld transported the surviving artifacts to [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] where they would be kept in the [[Jedi Archives/Legends|new Archives]] that would serve as a smaller version of the lost Library for centuries. After the planet had gone long without visitors aside from occasional archaeological teams [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and [[Kam Solusar]] rediscovered the world and begun to study the ruins. After several decades more had passed, the [[New Jedi Order|Jedi Order]] returned to the now-habitable planet and established a new [[Jedi Academy (Ossus)|academy]] on the world, erecting a new [[Jedi Archives (Ossus)|Archives]] to replace the Great Library.

==History==
===Jewel of the Jedi===
{{Quote|I remember the last words of my master Ooroo. Perhaps I can build a great learning center. A giant library of Jedi knowledge and books on the quiet world where Master Ooroo trained me. On Ossus!|[[Odan-Urr/Legends|Odan-Urr]] after recovering a [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Holocron/Legends|Holocron]] at the end of the [[Great Hyperspace War/Legends|Great Hyperspace War]]|<ref name="TOTJ:FOTSE" />}}
[[File:GreatLibraryOnOssus.jpg|thumb|left|200px|The Great Jedi Library's appearance was lost to history; ranging from a massive golden domed structure, to a squat, square building.]]
Following the end of the [[Great Hyperspace War/Legends|Great Hyperspace War]], [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Odan-Urr/Legends|Odan-Urr]], a noted [[Jedi Consular]] and [[Lore Keeper]] returned to the planet of his early [[Jedi training/Legends|training]] in the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] under [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Ooroo/Legends|Ooroo]]. Drawing inspiration from the expansive library found in the [[Jedi Praxeum (Ossus)/Legends|Praxeum]] in [[Knossa/Legends|Knossa]], Odan-Urr began to conceptualize a massive archive of wisdom on the quiet and meditative world of [[Ossus/Legends|Ossus]].<ref name="TOTJ:FOTSE" />

From the days of its foundation, the Library of Ossus contained the culmination of hundreds of generations of knowledge and wisdom. Odan-Urr scoured the galaxy for all attainable knowledge, eventually cataloging what was said to be data on all [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] works and history from the foundation of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Containing rare scrolls and hand-written books, many [[Jedi librarian/Legends|librarians]] and [[Jedi archivist/Legends|archivists]] recorded these text in more secure [[Datacron/Legends|datacrons]] and [[Hologram disc/Legends|holodiscs]] in order to ensure their preservation and integrity. Over time, the ever-growing collection was home to many [[Light side artifact|artifacts]] imbued with the [[Light side of the Force/Legends|light side of the Force]], including [[Holocron/Legends|holocrons]] of wise Jedi Masters and ancient weapons. As a historian, Master Odan-Urr understood that it was vital to maintain a comprehensiveness collection of knowledge; to this end he created the [[Chamber of Antiquities/Legends|Chamber of Antiquities]] to house [[Dark side artifact/Legends|objects and talismans]] tainted with the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]]. It was in this series of rooms that the [[Dark Holocron]] was kept, and like the other things kept in the chamber, accessible only to those with express permission from the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]] and the [[Keeper of Antiquities]], Odan-Urr himself.<ref name="POTJ" />

For over a millennium the Library of Ossus continued to grow, becoming a mecca of Jedi learning during the era. Many great Jedi Masters worked and studied within the Library's walls, tending the shelves and teaching future Knights the lessons that the past taught. [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-users]] from other Force-based religions also frequented the complex, studying alongside their Jedi cousins and other philosophers from around the Republic. Rivaled only by [[Obroa-skai/Legends|Obroa-skai's]] [[Celebratus Archive]] and the [[Halls of Knowledge/Legends|Halls of Knowledge]] on [[Phateem/Legends|Phateem]], the Great Library was the bright center of knowledge in the galaxy for nearly a thousand years.<ref name="POTJ" />

===Destruction in the Great Sith War===
In approximately [[3996 BBY]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> the [[Great Sith War/Legends|Great Sith War]] broke out and war came to the Republic.<ref name="SithWar">''[[Star Wars: Tales of the Jedi – The Sith War]]''</ref> Republic troops were funneled through Ossus and were occasionally staged on the world's surface.<ref name="GORW">''[[Geonosis and the Outer Rim Worlds]]''</ref> During the war, the Library was visited by the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Exar Kun/Legends|Exar Kun]], who seduced many young Jedi to the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]]. When he had gathered enough followers, he went to Master Odan-Urr in the Chamber of Antiquities and demanded that he turn over the Dark Holocron. When the ancient Jedi refused, Kun brutally slew him and took the [[Sith holocron/Legends|Sith holocron]]. Thus Odan-Urr died surrounded by the books he loved so much,<ref name="TSW1">[[Tales of the Jedi – The Sith War 1|''Tales of the Jedi – The Sith War'' 1]]</ref> just as his own teacher, Master Ooroo, had predicted.<ref name="TOTJ:FOTSE4">[[Tales of the Jedi – The Fall of the Sith Empire 4|''Tales of the Jedi – The Fall of the Sith Empire'' 4]]</ref>

Soon after, Kun's forces used an ancient Sith weapon aboard the Sith battleship, the [[Corsair (Derriphan-class)|''Corsair'']], to unleash a cataclysm that would wreck the surface of Ossus. Within a matter of hours, the Jedi were aware that the destruction of the [[Cron Cluster/Legends|Cron Cluster]] by the Sith would create a [[Cron Supernova/Legends|supernova]] that would wipe out all life on the world. As special teams of Jedi hastily recorded data and transferred artifacts aboard ships fleeing the system, other Jedi tried to save themselves and the other beings studying on the world. Scrolls, [[Datachip/Legends|datachips]], antique [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsabers]], and journals were loaded aboard transports while ancient mosaics and arcades were delicately removed from the floors and walls and placed in precise patterns in the vessels that would ferry them to safety.<ref name="GORW" /><ref name="SWCL">[[Star Wars: Complete Locations (2005)|''Star Wars: Complete Locations'']]</ref> Despite these heroic efforts, only a fraction of the ancient materials were saved, with the majority of them making it to [[Exis Station]] over [[Teedio]] where they would be stored in a temporary library before being transferred to the newly built [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="JvS">[[Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force (real-life book)|''Jedi vs Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force'']]</ref>

[[File:OssusEvacuation.jpg|thumb|right|200px|The Jedi's hasty evacuation of the Library.]]

===Return of the Sith===
The Library sat largely undisturbed for the next centuries. The Jedi Order relocated to their new home in the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] where they erected an expansive [[Jedi Archives/Legends|Archives]] facility to store what was saved from Ossus. Stone mosaics were inlaid in the Temple's floors, and a stained-glass arcade was installed after having been salvaged.<ref name="SWCL" /> As the Ysanna stood watch, the towers of the Library crumbled and the facade, most of which was already damaged, saw further deterioration. Eventually the Library blended in with the bleak landscape of the barren world, a mountain of crumbling rock amid the wrecks of ancient [[Star Cruiser/Legends|star cruisers]] and old [[Battleship/Legends|battleships]]. The Ysanna tribes eventually forgot the exact nature of the Library after centuries of distant protection, and its exact location became the stuff of legends. Despite its importance in Jedi history, the Jedi seldom held recovery missions on the planet, occasionally dispatching members of the [[Academy of Jedi Archaeology]] to accompany the scientists and researchers of the [[Hanna Institute of Antiquities/Legends|Hanna Institute of Antiquities]] and the [[University of Agamar]] on digs.<ref name="GORW" />

[[File:Great_Jedi_Library_battle.jpg|thumb|left|280px|Jedi and Sith battle in the Great Library during the [[third Galactic War]].]]
Following the [[Eternal Empire]]'s [[Eternal Empire conquest|conquest]] of the galaxy, Jedi under Master [[Gnost-Dural]]&mdash;along with the [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Pilgrims]] and other war [[Refugee/Legends|refugees]]&mdash;established the isolated [[Jedi Colony]] near the Great Jedi Library, exploring the ruins as they developed farms near the colony.<ref name="Jedi Under Siege">{{TORcite|exp=kotet|type=general|Jedi Under Siege|Ossus}}</ref> During their stay, the Ysanna often lured nearby and stole some tools but avoiding direct contact, which caused the colonists to be suspicious of their presence.<ref name="Codex">{{TORcite|exp=kotet|type=codex|Survivors of the Cron Supernova}}</ref>

Around [[3628 BBY]],<ref name="Year-5">{{TOR_updates|5.10.0}}</ref> the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] discovered the Jedi Colony and [[Invasion of Ossus|invaded]] Ossus in an attempt to destroy them but Republic forces reinforced the planet and fought the Imperial forces, allowing the colony to evacuate off-world.<ref name="Jedi Under Siege" />

===Rediscovery===
As the worlds of the Republic spun into [[Clone Wars/Legends|yet another war]], one that would claim the Republic and snuff out the Jedi Order, a young Ysanna tribesman rediscovered the ruins while exploring a region governed by fallen Jedi [[Travgen]]. Despite his inclinations to the dark side, Travgen had been hiding out on the world for several years, protecting the ruins as he ruled over a Ysanna tribe.<ref name="FCA">{{JournalCite|14|From the Files of Corellia Antilles}}</ref> Careful to keep the knowledge a family secret out of fear of looters, the man's grandson, [[Okko]] would be the keeper of this knowledge when the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] was in power.<ref name="DEII" />

[[File:OssusRuins.jpg|thumb|right|200px|Jedi Master [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Skywalker]] and [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Kam Solusar|Solusar]] fly across [[Ooroo Canyon/Legends|Ooroo Canyon]] on their approach to the ruins of the Great Library.]]

Roughly a [[10 ABY/Legends|decade]] after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] between the Empire and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]], [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and apprentice [[Kam Solusar]] traveled to Ossus in search of the remains of the Great Library. Led to the world via clues in an ancient holocron, Skywalker and his student landed on the world and immediately noted the Jedi's influence in the dilapidated buildings. Not long after their arrival, the Jedi were confronted by the Ysanna people and were forced to engage them in order to protect themselves. The Ysanna quickly noted that the two intruders were drawing on the [[Light side of the Force/Legends|light side of the Force]] and ended the attack. Rejoicing for the return of the Jedi after thousands of years, the celebration was short lived as Imperial forces had tracked the Jedi to the planet and begun an assault.<ref name="DEII" />

Led by Imperial [[Executor (Imperial rank)|Executor]] [[Sedriss QL]], the Empire's bravest [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] were unleashed on the Ysanna tribe. Aided by the Jedi, the natives drove off their attackers until Sedriss remained. Driven near the ruins of the old Jedi fortress, Jedi Skywalker [[Skirmish on Ossus|engaged]] the Executor in a worn courtyard. As Sedriss attempted to kill a [[Jem Ysanna|young Ysanna girl]], Skywalker [[Telekinesis/Legends|telekinetically]] hurled Sedriss into a gnarled tree dominating the courtyard. As Sedriss struggled, the tree transformed into the ancient form of Neti Jedi Master [[Ood Bnar]] and entrapped the dark sider in his vines. Sensing Sedriss' power, Bnar used his remaining energies to destroy the man, costing him his own life.<ref name="DEII" />

[[File:DEOssusLibrary.jpg|thumb|left|230px|The Jedi and Ysanna leaders explore the ruins of the Hall of Knowledge.]]
Despite the loss of Master Bnar and his ancient wisdom, Skywalker and Solusar had reason to be celebrant. Beneath the spot Bnar had occupied survived the ancient lightsabers he had hidden millennia earlier. Collecting the weapons and finding them still in working order, the Jedi forged a good relationship with the Ysanna tribe and began to make plans to excavate the ruins.<ref name="DEII" /> The two Jedi were escorted through the ruins of the Great Library, and found many of the ancient scrolls and books remained in good condition. With the help of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]], Skywalker's [[New Jedi Order|reformed Jedi Order]] began to delve deep into the ancient structure, taking with them all retrievable data for study. Assisted by the [[Obroan Institute for Archaeology]], the [[Hanna Institute of Antiquities/Legends|Hanna Institute of Antiquities]], the [[New Republic Archaeological Corps]], and the [[University of Agamar]], the Jedi were able to recover a significant portion of the lost relics and preserve them for future study by the Jedi Order.<ref name="GORW" />

Research at the site was curtailed during the [[Yuuzhan Vong War|invasion of the galaxy]] by the [[Yuuzhan Vong]]. As the fledgling Jedi Order was once more brought to the brink of annihilation, the knowledge kept on Ossus was left hidden and survived the ruinous destruction of the libraries on [[Obroa-skai/Legends|Obroa-skai]].<ref name="GORW" /> Following the end of the war, the newly formed [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] funded the construction of a new [[Jedi Academy (Ossus)|Jedi headquarters]] on Ossus. Erecting an inverted zigurrat-shaped [[Jedi academy|academy]], the Jedi Order founded a new [[Jedi Archives (Ossus)|Archives]] in which all relics and data housed in the Great Library ruins were moved to and stored.<ref name="JvS" />

==Layout==
Erected atop a lone hill above [[Ooroo Canyon/Legends|Ooroo Canyon]], the Great Library was established several days walking distance from the ancient Jedi city [[Knossa/Legends|Knossa]]. The exact appearance of the Great Library varied from source to source, mainly due to deceptive floor plans peddled by the con-artist [[Skavak/Legends|Skavak]]. Many scholars struggled to distinguish between the facades of the Great Library, the [[Knossa Branch Library/Legends|Knossa Branch Library]], and the [[Eye of Ashlanae/Legends|Eye of Ashlanae]]. What was known was that the Great Library complex consisted of several different buildings which ranged in size and shape and sprawled down into the canyon and surrounding areas. Carved out of unadorned dense stone like most of the structures on Ossus, the Great Library appeared to be a natural feature of the hill.<ref name="NoP" />

[[File:GreatJediLibrary.jpg|thumb|left|260px|Great Jedi Library during the Third Galactic War.]]
The Great Library's purpose was simply to serve as the largest collection of known information in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. Its founder, Odan-Urr, believed that any and all forms of knowledge would be used as a potential benefit for the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]]. With the exception of the highest level, the building blocked out all natural light; instead artificial light kept the building at a constantly even light so the passage of the suns' light did not increase the weariness of a devoted learner. While many items were indeed stored at the Library, a select few were housed in the submerged satellite structures at nearby [[Imhar Canyon/Legends|Imhar Canyon]]; artifacts needing to be kept in water or in moist environments.<ref name="POTJ" /> Remote access to the library was granted to the [[Knossa Branch Library/Legends|branch library]] in the city of [[Knossa/Legends|Knossa]], where scholars used holobooks directly tied into the Great Library's central computer. Researchers there could also remotely control droids within the Great Library facility to interact with hard copy manuscripts and ancient scrolls contained within special environment control facilities.<ref name="NoP" />

Access to the Great Library was granted through many doorways and gates on the main level, atop dozens of stone stairs climbing from the base of the hill. Odan-Urr believed no door should be barred and that all should share in the Order' knowledge, and therefore there were no doors or locks that forbid entrance into the facility. The main public area of the Great Library's collections was known as the [[Hall of Knowledge/Legends|Hall of Knowledge]], open to the public and encompassing chambers on multiple levels and functions. Containing [[astrogation map]]s and Jedi journals; philosophical and biological text; datacrons on starship design and cultural records, the Hall of Knowledge was sprawling and exhaustive. [[Jedi librarian/Legends|Jedi librarians]] prowled the Stacks here, ready to assist researchers in their search for knowledge. Among the chambers within the Hall were several archives, classrooms, study and reading rooms, information desks and kiosks, and office space for the many Lore Keepers on staff. Among the buildings attached to the library was a dormitory complex and a small hangar and landing platforms. Most pilgrims to the Great Library were forced to first land at the more accommodating [[Knossa Spaceport/Legends|Knossa Spaceport]] some distance away and join local traffic to the facility.<ref name="NoP" />

[[File:Great_Jedi_Library_interior.jpg|thumb|right|260px|One of the archive rooms of the Great Library]]
Despite Odan-Urr's beliefs that the Library should be accessible to all, he understood that some knowledge was too potent for free access. With this in mind, the Draethos Jedi ordered the construction of three sublevels, the second and third of which would house the [[Chamber of Antiquities/Legends|Chamber of Antiquities]]. Not just a single room, the Chamber was divided and subdivided into a Byzantine labyrinth that was difficult to navigate, including rooms such as the [[Vault of Justice]]. Fashioned in such a manner intentionally, the Chamber held many secrets, including [[Sith holocron/Legends|Sith holocrons]] and other [[Dark side artifact/Legends|dark side artifacts]]. Access to the Chamber was granted to the few who gained express permission from the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]] and the [[Keeper of Antiquities]].<ref name="POTJ" />
